design.screening: Round robin over all 8 unique candidates; every unordered pair; both seats; same fixed seeds for every pair.
design.confirmation: After screening, final two compete against each other and all six non-finalists on a fresh matched seed panel, both seats; report holdout-only estimates.
design.seed_disjointness_note: Screening and confirmation seeds are disjoint from prior selection-panel seeds and captured P0 replay seeds.
design.finalist_selection_rule: Finalist selection must use screening match-points rate, then mean terminal margin, then candidate ID ascending; public scores and the prior historical tournament do not determine finalists. Confirmation is fresh and held out.
design.uncertainty_reporting: Report uncertainty by whole-seed cluster; do not treat seat swaps as independent seeds.
design.primary: match win points (win=1/tie=.5/loss=0); official rating uses outcome, not coin margin
design.safety: Record status, exceptions, invalid matches, source/manifest hashes, agent telemetry, callback counts, total durations and max/p95 latency; local GEMINI.md states a strict 100ms callback guideline. No Kaggle uploads or submissions.
